d4ba9c6261b4a52a1f47e356034890a24e0e43e1:
Refund aapke item ki quality check ke baad aapke original payment method par aayega.  

- **Standard**: 5‑7 business days  
- **UPI**: 2‑3 business days (usually faster)  
- **Credit/Debit Card**: 10 business days tak lag sakta hai, bank par depend karta hai  
- **Cash on Delivery**: aapke bank account mein transfer hoga (bank details chahiye hongi)  

Quality check ke baad ye timeline follow hoti hai.
